summary: The Ha Giang Loop is the motorbike road. Ride it with the right license, or sit with a driver. Cao Bang is the other northern road.
body: The loop is passes, minority markets, and buckwheat flowers in autumn. The town of Ha Giang is only the start. The road leaves toward Quan Ba, Yen Minh, Dong Van, and Meo Vac, and Ma Pi Leng is the famous stretch. A Vietnamese motorcycle license is what makes riding legal. Many shops still rent bikes to visitors without one.

Cao Bang is the border cascade and the geopark roads, which leave town in different directions. Hire a car or a motorbike in the city for those roads. The bus time from Hanoi is check on arrival.
